node.title: Universal two-core exact numerator: LD_sw(RS[F,D,256],426) = 87 for EVERY field and 512-domain
node.statement: Hankel-free structural theorem (proof written in #204, flips PROVED on integration): for every finite field F and every 512-point D, LD_sw(RS[F,D,256],426) = 87 exactly. Universal in the field AND the domain — the first exact window-edge value, and domain-universality exceeds anything the tangent-range pin required.
node.notes: the P3 slate's qualitative jump: exact numerators exist OUTSIDE the tangent range
